name: -10 AN Hex/Worm-Clamp Hose Finisher
description: ColorFittings Worm Clamp Hose End Finishers are designed to transform ordinary worm gear hose clamps into a clean, show-quality detail for your engine bay. Perfect for coolant, vacuum, intercooler, breather, and other rubber hose applications, these finishers provide a sleek, professional appearance while concealing the industrial look of standard hose clamps.\nPrecision CNC-machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings’ proprietary anodizing process, these one-piece beauty covers offer exceptional durability, corrosion resistance, and long-lasting color retention. Whether you’re building a race car, show car, or street vehicle, they add the finishing touch that elevates your plumbing and engine bay presentation.\nLooking to complete your system?
